routes.result: The June 2026 release documents a wide Comprehensive File and a long Comprehensive Panel Dataset; the panel has one respondent-by-wave observation, is updated quarterly, includes health, financial, employment, and wellbeing domains, and can be linked with uasid.
Non-registered users may inspect survey variables but cannot view or download respondent data; registered-user files include completed-survey weights and documented UAS missing-value codes.

UAS 537 exposes utilization, billing, perceptions, satisfaction/access, and health-status sections; the page reports 1,136 completed surveys from 1,233 selected respondents and requires login for download.
The current documentation lists UAS HRS Waves 16 and 17 and states that public release files require UAS permission; uasid remains the stable merge key and the file includes sample weights.

workspace_retention.interpretation: No UAS respondent file is currently retained in the workspace; this is not evidence that no copy exists outside the workspace.

acquisition_priority.first_file: Older Ages Monthly Events Panel and codebook
acquisition_priority.reason: It is the narrower event-first route for adults aged 50+, with documented prior-month event timing and follow-up health, work, earnings, pain, life-satisfaction, and medical-expenditure fields.
gates_before_estimate: verify wave timing and event-date fields
measure overlap between event and follow-up fields
stop if remedy, trust, action, or recovery fields are absent

evidence_boundary: The live official documentation advances acquisition readiness and confirms a current panel product, but no respondent-level estimate, event overlap, remedy receipt, trust, action, or recovery result is promoted.
